name: Speak Text (Google Chirp 3 HD)
description: Speak up to 5,000 bytes of text as an MP3 with a Google Chirp 3 HD voice, saved on the tool server for tts.fetch. Counted against Google's free 1 million characters a month; a piece that would pass the month's cap is refused with TTS_CAP_REACHED (free only unless the owner allows paid characters).
requires: GOOGLE_TTS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT in the vault (a Google Cloud service account key file)
aliases: read this aloud as an mp3
